detail: Source (beyondkimchee.com) grinds 15 cardamom pods into the signature Cape Malay spice blend; cardamom appears nowhere in our list or steps.
Source blend includes 2 tsp ground fennel; absent from our card, whose list instead carries 2.5 tbsp Italian Seasoning that appears nowhere in the source recipe.

We buy 21.6 potatoes (4609 g) and the dish is titled 'Beef and Potato Stew', but no step ever adds potatoes; the source (isabeleats.com) contains no potatoes, so the steps track the source while the list added an ingredient the cook never uses.
Final step says 'then cook the rice separately' but rice is not in our costed ingredient list (source serves with tortillas/Mexican rice as a side suggestion only).

https://www.budgetbytes.com/cheeseburger-rice/ returns HTTP 404, and a site-restricted search finds no 'Cheeseburger Rice' recipe on budgetbytes.com (nearest match is 'One Pot Cheeseburger Pasta' at /skillet-cheeseburger-pasta/).
1 Tbsp (50 g) Worcestershire is in the costed list but the five steps (brown beef, stir in broth/tomatoes/ketchup/dijon/garlic, simmer, rice, cheese) never mention it.
1 Tbsp (45 g) olive oil is costed but no step uses any oil; the beef is browned with no fat mentioned.
Salt (1 tsp) and black pepper (1/2 tsp) are costed but no step salts, peppers, or says 'season' anywhere.

Step 4 says 'Add the garlic and diced jalapenos' but no jalapenos are in the costed list; source (ohsweetbasil.com) uses no jalapenos either, so the step likely garbles the Ro-Tel green chilies that ARE bought.
0.5 tbsp black pepper is costed but no step uses pepper or says 'season' (salt is used in the pasta water only).
4 cloves garlic are costed but no step ever adds garlic; the source (confessionsofafitfoodie.com) contains no garlic at all, so it was added to the list but never wired into the method.
2 cups (720 g) beef broth are costed but never used; step 6 tells the cook to 'splash in a quarter cup of water' instead, and the source uses only water.
Step 3 says to heat 'a little olive oil' but the list buys vegetable/canola oil, not olive oil.
Black pepper 'to taste (2 g)' is costed but no step uses pepper or says 'season' (only a 'pinch of salt' in step 4).
Final step says 'Cook the rice separately and put a scoop in the bottom of each container' but rice is not in the costed ingredient list.
The list carries 'Milk (Fairlife): 0 tbsp (1 g)' - a vestige of the source's optional saffron-soaked-in-milk step - and no step ever uses milk.
0.5 tbsp black pepper is costed but no step uses pepper or says 'season' (the marinade and rice steps use salt only).

Step 6 toasts 'the cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, garam masala, and chili powder' but coriander is not in our costed list, even though it is 1 tsp of the source's (seasonsandsuppers.ca) core six-spice blend.
0.5 tbsp black pepper is costed but no step uses pepper or says 'season'.
Salt (1 tbsp) and black pepper (0.5 tbsp) are costed but no step salts the noodle water, seasons the chicken, or says 'season'.

Source (chilipeppermadness.com) finishes the chicken in a mole poblano sauce built on dried chiles (ancho/guajillo/pasilla/mulato) and chocolate; our card sells 'Chicken Mole' but its sauce is only fresh poblano + peanut + chili powder, with no dried chiles or chocolate anywhere.

1.25 lb of sausage is costed and the dish is titled 'Chicken and Sausage Gumbo', but no step ever browns or adds the sausage; the source (africanbites.com) browns it in step 2 and returns it near the end.
Step 5 adds 'garlic, thyme, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, bay leaves, salt, and pepper' but italian seasoning is not in the costed list (and is not in the source either).

WebFetch is blocked from www.thespruceeats.com ('Claude Code is unable to fetch from www.thespruceeats.com'), so the source at /chiles-rellenos-casserole-3057402 could not be read; our card's internal list-vs-steps check found no defect.
Step 5 says to 'add the thyme and bay leaves' but bay leaves are not in our costed ingredient list.
Step 8 says to 'knead the rest of the butter with flour into a paste' (the source's beurre manie thickener) but flour is not in our costed ingredient list.
